name: Gaussian Rasterization Variable Preparation
definition: Prepares a dictionary of PyTorch tensors containing 3D Gaussian parameters filtered by timestep, formatted for the differentiable Gaussian rasterizer.
summary: Gaussian Rasterization Variable Preparation filters raw parameters by timestep, normalizes latent values into physical attributes, and packages them for the CUDA backend, distinguishing itself through temporal filtering and specific tensor shape adjustments.
